soak.seatConnectionNote: Both seats were present at the start and remained connected from the 462/469 ms recovery until the final result. They were disconnected for about 0.47 s at the runtime restart, and their clients rejected updates for the following 20.13 s while epochs caught up.
soak.commandLoad: Both seats issued commands for the whole match: seat 0 sent 359 and seat 1 sent 94. Seat 0 carried the larger share (about 79%), so this was not an equal two-sided pressure test.
soak.scenario: island-assault, fixed seed, 1v1, fog enabled, AI disabled
soak.restartTicksMissingObservedBasis: command ack tick 21015 at 20:45:28.778Z; next ack tick 21043 at 20:45:33.800Z; 5.022 s at 20 Hz predicts 100.4 ticks

steadyStateTickDeltas.note: The single large delta is the rejected-message recovery interval, not a change in simulation step.

cpu.interpretation: Aggregate platform CPU for the complete room. The per-tick figures are derived divisions, not per-tick measurements. CPU per minute rose after the restart and stayed higher; this is a level shift, not a continuing upward trend. Workload and recovery differences prevent attribution.

memory.memoryPercentiles: p50, p90, p99 and p999 equal the reported maximum in every bucket
memory.interpretation: The pre-restart series rose, but a 26.7 MiB fall occurred at 20:51:31 with the same object id and no socket close. This supports runtime heap reclamation rather than a monotonic application leak. Cloudflare exposes no retained-heap metric, so a slow leak cannot be excluded.

restart.evidence: Both sockets closed within 3 ms with no close code. Room diagnostics restarted at tick count 0 and startedAt 20:45:31.600Z while the authoritative room restored at about tick 21,030. Platform invocation records show responseStreamDisconnected on the original sockets with no fatalInternalErrors.
restart.cause: Not established. Consistent with a platform isolate/object restart, not an application exception.

persistence.fullMatchBytesUnavailableReason: The restart reset the in-process persistence counters; Cloudflare does not expose per-room write bytes in the collected datasets.

comparison.interpretation: The ordinary sustained room cost is essentially unchanged from the pre-2A.8 Phase 2A.4 soak. This is not a test of the mass-order burst that Phase 2A.8 targeted and does not contradict the controlled Phase 2A.9 A/B result. Workload, commands and network bytes differ, so the totals are not a controlled comparison.
